name: currency-input
title: Currency Input
description: An amount of money typed the way the locale writes it (its decimal mark, its grouping, its symbol before or after), shown formatted when the field is left, kept as a plain number, with Up and Down to step it and a range it is held to.

meta.when: Prices, budgets, transfers, any amount in a currency. Also numbers with a unit through `unit` instead of `currency` (kilograms, percent). For a small whole number with buttons use number-stepper; for a range use slider.
meta.example: <CurrencyInput aria-label="Budget" currency="EUR" locale="de-DE" defaultValue={1250.5} min={0} name="budget" />
